Semi-supervised learning
What is it?
In this learning scenario, there are a few labeled example data
and many unlabelled data.
labeling data is expensive; there is abundance of unlabelled
data.
The problem is how to learn the underlying model that can
best classify the whole data into given categories despite lack
of many labeled data.
